summary: Completed one continuous offline YouTube content-acquisition v2 checkpoint. Added a documented capability contract, fail-closed normalizer and validator, storage-neutral KU2D-to-KU2A dataset schema, comprehensive synthetic fixtures, YT2-1 through YT2-132 deterministic coverage, CI wiring, and a readiness report. The contract distinguishes public metadata/comment reads from owner-authorized caption methods, retains transcript text only for Thai and English, keeps optional absence distinct from technical failure, and defines the nine-stage YouTube Acquisition Pattern v2. PR #61 is Ready, open, green, mergeable, and unmerged. No live YouTube API/content request, caption download, comment acquisition, OAuth flow, browser/Edge activity, authority mutation, production action, scheduling, or merge occurred.

youtube_v2_results.exit_0: technical completion, evidence written, all required modules resolved, required Deep Audit gates passed; optional absence remains explicit
youtube_v2_results.exit_2: technical completion and evidence written, but a required module, provenance, coverage, or audit gate is withheld
youtube_v2_results.exit_1: technical/runtime, quota-accounting, relationship-integrity, contract-integrity, or evidence-writing failure

mapped_capabilities: channel identity, metadata, statistics, and uploads playlist
video metadata, content details, status, statistics, topics, and live state
metadata_capability_results.statistics_semantics: timestamped observation snapshots, not causal explanations
unavailable_or_not_inferred: generic resource updated_at where the API does not expose it
public dislike count for non-owner reads
caption track identity or text from videos.list

transcript_language_and_capability_contr.public_videos_list_caption_field: availability flag only; no track identity, text, or authorization inference
transcript_language_and_capability_contr.absence_behavior: no_captions, unsupported_language_only, or owner_authorization_required is not automatically a technical extraction failure

comments_contract_results.public_read_capability: official Data API reads for published comment threads and replies where enabled
comments_contract_results.embedded_reply_behavior: may be partial; totalReplyCount must be compared with returned replies before bounded comments.list use
comments_contract_results.ordering_behavior: requested/API ordering is acquisition context only, never representativeness, sentiment, popularity, or demand
comments_contract_results.absence_behavior: comments_disabled and no_comments are explicit non-technical statuses; moderation/deletion can make sampling incomplete

dataset_intake_results.relationship_integrity: video, playlist, thread, parent-comment, track, and segment identities are validated fail-closed

deep_audit_contract.metadata: 100% identity, provenance, and timestamp-snapshot typing; 0% duplicate identity
deep_audit_contract.transcript: 100% allowed-language text, track provenance, relationship integrity, and timestamp-gap disclosure; zero unsupported-language text
deep_audit_contract.comments: 100% identity/relationship integrity, provenance, pagination disclosure, and publish/update timestamp typing; zero representativeness claims
deep_audit_contract.dataset: 100% required-module resolution, entity uniqueness, and cross-entity relationship integrity; production approval false

remaining_gaps: Thai and English caption acquisition needs separately authorized owner evidence
public comment pagination, disabled-state, quota, and reply-completeness behavior has not been live validated
no approved durable official public transcript-text method is available
the two-page comment boundary is a proposal, not an observed coverage guarantee
remaining_gaps_and_future_pilot.caption_execution: only after separate explicit owner authorization; otherwise preserve owner_authorized_only/evidence_withheld

verification.python_compilation: acquisition, api, repository, control_plane, service, tools passed under Python 3.12

completed_queue_summary.work_completed: Completed KU2D-BH-000009 and one continuous offline YouTube v2 checkpoint: capability contract, fail-closed normalization/validation, storage-neutral dataset schema, synthetic fixtures, readiness report, YT2-1 through YT2-132, CI coverage, and Ready PR #61.
completed_queue_summary.key_findings_results: Official public API methods cover rich metadata plus published comments/replies, while caption track metadata and text are owner-authorized. Only Thai/English transcript text may be retained, with manual-original before manual-translated before auto-original before auto-translated. Optional transcript/comment absence does not force technical failure. Pattern APL-YOUTUBE-002 and KU2D-to-KU2A Dataset Intake are offline-contract ready but not live validated or authorized.
completed_queue_summary.repo_knowledge_state_changes: Added only offline acquisition contracts, implementation-free transport boundaries, a dataset schema, fixtures, documentation, tests, coordination Result, and CI coverage. Existing YouTube v1 policy remains unchanged with comments and arbitrary transcripts disabled; no knowledge authority, reviewed corpus, production approval, or scheduler state changed.
completed_queue_summary.important_out_of_scope_actions_not_perfo: No live YouTube API/content request, caption download, live comment read, OAuth/owner flow, browser/Edge acquisition, audio/video download, HTML scraping, undocumented endpoint, authority promotion, parked-reference mutation, production/store/scheduler action, analytics/ML, Survey/DoE/SEM, integration/main mutation, cleanup, or PR merge.
completed_queue_summary.remaining_blockers_risks: Transcript content requires separate owner authorization and permission to edit the video; there is no approved durable public transcript-text method. Comment pagination, disabled states, reply completeness, and quota behavior remain offline-only. Optional-module policies must stay explicit so absence is not conflated with failure, and statistics/order/counts must never be promoted into causal, representative, sentiment, or demand claims.
completed_queue_summary.recommended_next_logical_step: Assistant independently reviews KU2D-R-000034 and Ready PR #61. If accepted and later integrated, request separate human governance for the smallest non-production Q-Diving pilot: exactly two reviewed videos, public metadata plus at most two comment pages per video, Thai/English caption handling only, and caption execution only with explicit owner authorization; do not infer authorization from this Result.
